title: Closed Hydrant and Parked Hose Curbside Bay
description: One static curbside hydrant preparation-bay scene from the original firefighting water-point layout direction. One scene, zero new standalone models. One complete published three-outlet hydrant remains fully capped, and one whole supported hose reel retains its six-turn wound hose and downward nozzle parked in its original retaining collar. Both original unit-scale props stand separately on the raised rear service bay and face the lower front approach apron. One broad central wedge ramp links the two platform heights and aligns with the genuinely unoccupied corridor between the two complete equipment envelopes. The three new closed scene-only support pieces are an apron, raised bay and ramp; they are not new independent assets or a claimed fused watertight shell.58meshes11494tri10PBR. All original whole world triangles, original static poses and per-face opaque PBR are retained with only declared translations and collision-safe names. Distinct from the old fire cabinet with two extinguishers and the village hand-pump/drain/sign scene: this presents a capped hydrant-side preparation area with a parked reel, raised curb and clear front-to-rear approach. No artificial hose connection, uncoiled hose, outlet change, fluid, pressure, flow, uncapping, operating instructions, plumbing compatibility, vehicle turning/accessibility, construction, load or fire-safety certification. No people, textures or labels. Original interaction hierarchy/custom corner normals are not claimed preserved. Preview ground excluded.
